---
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-level: 2
    slide-number: c/t
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: main
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
      - name: expert
        level: 5
        shown: false
      - name: extra
      - name: backup
        shown: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The Reveal.js adapter detaches hidden slides, keeps the deck in sync, and sends the state to the speaker view and multiplex.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<script type="application/json" id="veil-config">', '<section id="part-b"[^>]*data-veil-hidden']
        - ['<section id="ghost"']
---

## One {#one .veil group="main"}

Text MKONE.

## Ghost {#ghost data-visibility="hidden"}

Text MKGHOST.

## Two {#two .veil group="advanced"}

Text MKTWO.

## Three {#three .veil group="main"}

::: {.fragment}

Fragment one MKFRAGONE.

:::

::: {.veil group="extra"}

::: {.fragment}

Fragment two MKFRAGTWO.

:::

::: {.fragment}

Fragment three MKFRAGTHREE.

:::

:::

::: {.notes}

Speaker note MKNOTETHREE.

:::

## Expert {#expert .veil group="expert"}

Text MKEXPERT.

## Anim one {#anim-one .veil group="main" auto-animate="true"}

Text MKANIMONE.

## Anim two {#anim-two .veil group="main" auto-animate="true"}

Text MKANIMTWO.

## Uncounted {#uncounted .veil group="main" visibility="uncounted"}

Text MKUNCOUNTED.

# Part A {#part-a .veil group="main"}

## A1 {#a1 .veil group="main"}

Text MKAONE.

## A2 {#a2 .veil group="expert"}

Text MKATWO.

# Part B {#part-b .veil group="backup"}

## B1 {#b1 .veil group="main"}

Text MKBONE.

## B2 {#b2 .veil group="main"}

Text MKBTWO.

# Part C {#part-c .veil group="extra"}

## C1 {#c1 .veil group="extra"}

Text MKCONE.
